## What’s new

- Incoming transfers and loans recheck the receiving club’s cash, transfer budget and wage affordability before changing the deal.
- Oversized transfer fees are rejected safely in financial previews.
- Matchday squads exclude retired players; completed matches reject substitutions and tactical changes.
- Active-loan reporting resets correctly at season rollover. Calendar birthday checks now handle leap years accurately.
- Career save/reload coverage includes recruitment strategies, alongside old-save migration checks.
- Updated What’s New summaries in all 12 supported languages.
